changelog:
Initial release of Claude Code (小c): heavy-duty code AI skill for code review, generation, diagnosis, and design.

- Adds CLI-based “小c” for complex code tasks, coordinated by the main “笨笨” agent.
- Provides usage guide and task delegation rules: when to use 小c vs. 笨笨.
- Includes command templates for code generation, review, project edits, and architecture analysis.
- Details integration with related skills (coding-agent, self-improving, proactivity).
- Documents setup paths, workflow, and best practices for prompt writing.
- Lists key considerations and memory file locations.
